verdict.rationale: Conta Simples' own API documents retrieval of much account data: card and bank statements, receipt downloads, credit card bills, categories, cost centers, suppliers, users and cards. A user could pull their data out programmatically, but there is no documented bulk 'export everything' feature, and the formats are not specified. missing for 10: a documented full-account export, explicitly named open formats (e.g. CSV/OFX/JSON), coverage of all data types, an account-closure/offboarding path, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
